ETL Validation: Source-to-Target Reconciliation in Freight Warehouses

12 min read Updated: November 2026 By Rajvardhan Singh Rathore
How do you guarantee that 10 million milestone events ingested into Kafka land accurately in Snowflake without loss, silent truncation, or duplication? This guide details automated source-to-target reconciliation pipelines.

The Three Reconciliation Gates

Source-to-target reconciliation verifies three key invariants:

  • Row Count Parity: Ingestion partition row count equals warehouse inserted row count.
  • Numerical Sum Parity: Sum of declared weights and invoice charges matches exactly between raw and gold layers.
  • Attribute Fidelity: Timestamps, codes, and IDs suffer zero unintended transformation shifts.

Row Hash Checksum Comparison

Compute MD5 or SHA-256 hashes of concatenated attributes across both source staging and final analytics tables:

PostgreSQL Checksum Reconciliation 
WITH source_hashes AS (
  SELECT 
    shipment_id,
    MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', shipment_id, carrier_scac, declared_weight_kg, current_status)) AS src_hash
  FROM stg_shipments
  WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
),
target_hashes AS (
  SELECT 
    shipment_id,
    MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', shipment_id, carrier_scac, declared_weight_kg, current_status)) AS tgt_hash
  FROM dim_shipments
  WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.shipment_id, t.shipment_id) AS shipment_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN t.shipment_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_IN_TARGET_WAREHOUSE'
    WHEN s.shipment_id IS NULL THEN 'PHANTOM_RECORD_IN_TARGET'
    WHEN s.src_hash != t.tgt_hash THEN 'HASH_MISMATCH_DATA_DRIFT'
    ELSE 'MATCHED'
  END AS reconciliation_status
FROM source_hashes s
FULL OUTER JOIN target_hashes t ON s.shipment_id = t.shipment_id
WHERE s.src_hash IS DISTINCT FROM t.tgt_hash;

Temporal Watermark Row Count Parity

By comparing Kafka high-watermark consumer offsets against database primary key sequences, pipelines detect lost batches before analytical dashboards generate executive reports.
